# FlexiTap POS

> FlexiTap POS is an offline-first point-of-sale (POS) and merchant operating system engineered for small retail businesses, convenience stores, cafes, restaurants, food trucks, and professional service venues. Operates with 100% functionality on an embedded local SQLite database even when internet connectivity drops.

## Core Value Proposition
- **Offline-First Resilience**: Ring up orders, scan barcodes, calculate change, apply tax/discounts, split bills, and print ESC/POS receipts & kitchen order tickets (KOT) with zero internet dependency.
- **Zero Cloud Latency**: Counter tenders and 100,000+ SKU barcode lookups execute in under 15ms directly on local device hardware.
- **BYOD (Bring Your Own Device)**: Runs on existing Windows 10/11 PCs & touchscreens, Android tablets & Sunmi terminals, and Apple iPadOS / iOS devices. Zero proprietary hardware lease lock-ins.
- **Zero Processor Lock-In**: Keep your existing bank merchant account and external card terminal (PAX, Ingenico, Verifone, Maya, etc.) with zero forced payment processing markups.
- **Local Network Sync (mDNS)**: Multi-terminal registers, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), and Customer Displays (CDS) synchronize directly over local Wi-Fi/LAN without requiring cloud servers.
- **Automatic Cloud Back Office Sync**: Paid plans automatically replicate encrypted transaction deltas, Z-reads, and multi-store inventory to the cloud when connectivity is available.

## Industry Verticals & Solutions
- [Retail, Convenience & Boutique POS](https://flexitapapp.com/pos-for-retail.html): High-speed 1D/2D USB & Bluetooth barcode scanning for small retail businesses, convenience stores, and clothing shops (size/color variant matrices, parked sales, receiving & stockroom audits).
- [Cafes, Coffee Shops & Bakeries](https://flexitapapp.com/pos-for-cafes.html): Free coffee shop POS software with rapid milk/syrup modifier groups, barista KOT routing, iPad/Android/Windows touch support, and offline cash drawer kick.
- [Quick-Serve & Food Trucks](https://flexitapapp.com/pos-for-quick-service.html): 3-second counter checkouts, multi-station Kitchen Display System (KDS) bump bar routing, and order status pickup displays.
- [Fine Dining & Full-Service Restaurants](https://flexitapapp.com/pos-for-fine-dining.html): Visual floor plans, timed course firing (appetizers, mains, desserts), seat-level bill splitting, and sommelier wine cellar inventory tracking.
- [Professional Services, Salons & Spas](https://flexitapapp.com/pos-for-professional-services.html): Visual appointment timeline booking, staff commission attribution, and zero per-booking marketplace commissions.

## Competitor Comparisons
- [Loyverse POS Alternative](https://flexitapapp.com/loyverse-pos-alternative.html): True local SQLite offline reliability, built-in employee/inventory management without monthly per-employee add-on fees, universal ESC/POS printer support, and 1-click Loyverse CSV menu import.

## Key Hardware Compatibility
- **Receipt & Kitchen Printers**: ESC/POS compliant thermal printers (Ethernet LAN, USB, Bluetooth BLE, Wi-Fi, Serial, AirPrint, Star Micronics, Epson TM series, Sunmi internal printers).
- **Barcode Scanners**: 1D UPC/EAN and 2D QR barcode scanner guns operating via USB HID keyboard emulation or Bluetooth SPP/HID.
- **Cash Drawers**: Standard RJ11/RJ12 24V printer-driven kick ports.
- **Operating Systems**: Windows 10/11 (.exe), Android 8.0+ & Sunmi (.apk), iPadOS / iOS, and Web.

## Transparent Pricing Plans
- **Free Community Edition ($0 forever)**: 1 active POS register terminal, 100% offline local SQLite database, barcode scanning, ESC/POS receipt printing, local Z-read backups, and Support PWA access.
- **Plus Edition ($290/year or monthly option)**: Single-store Cloud Back Office reporting suite, remote menu & inventory sync, multi-terminal local LAN sync, and technical support desk.
- **Pro Edition ($590/year or monthly option)**: Multi-store Cloud Back Office, Kitchen Display (KDS) & Customer Display (CDS) station routing, AI sales insights, remote support utility, and priority engineering care.
